benchmark_reason_no_baseline_metric: No baseline metric with the same case and metric identity.
benchmark_reason_unknown_metric_directio: Metric direction is unknown and requires project configuration.
benchmark_reason_insufficient_samples: Insufficient raw samples for a high-confidence gate.
benchmark_reports_subtitle: Compare baselines, track regressions and export release evidence.
benchmark_gate_reason_incompatible_evide: Environment incompatibility takes precedence over the regression verdict.
benchmark_gate_reason_blocking_regressio: Blocking regressions exceed what the policy allows.
benchmark_gate_reason_inconclusive_evide: Some comparisons are inconclusive or carry too few samples.
benchmark_gate_reason_inconclusive_disal: The policy does not allow inconclusive evidence.
benchmark_gate_reason_no_blocking_regres: No blocking regression under the active release gate policy.
benchmark_no_comparisons: No comparisons match the current filters.
benchmark_trend_environment_varies: Trend mixes devices or API levels; the points are not directly comparable.
benchmark_trend_low_sample: Some points have fewer than {minimum} samples.
benchmark_trend_empty: Import two or more runs of the same metric to plot a trend.
benchmark_inspect_hint: Select a row to inspect its evidence.
benchmark_reports_missing_source: Source file is no longer available: {path}
benchmark_orchestrate_subtitle: Runs the same plan as the APS CLI macro-run command and imports the produced JSON.
benchmark_orchestrate_result_missing: Run finished but no benchmark JSON was found. Set the result path or point at the project output.
benchmark_orchestrate_project_missing: The project root is not a directory.
benchmark_orchestrate_timeout_invalid: Timeout must be a positive number of seconds.
benchmark_session_only: Runs and trends are retained in this app session only; persistent history is not connected.
benchmark_empty: Import AndroidX Benchmark JSON, select a baseline and current run, then compare.
benchmark_run_limit: This session reached the {count}-run limit. Close the workspace before importing more runs.
benchmark_import_cancelled: Import cancelled; the previous run and report are retained.
benchmark_import_invalid: This file cannot be imported as bounded AndroidX Benchmark JSON. The previous evidence is retained.
benchmark_compare_failed: Comparison failed; the previous report is retained.
benchmark_compare_cancelled: Comparison cancelled; the previous report is retained.
benchmark_selection_changed: Run or policy selection changed. Compare again to publish an updated report.
benchmark_same_run: Select two different runs for a comparison.
benchmark_export_scope: JSON/CSV contains the published comparison page and policy metadata, not a lossless run archive or PDF report.
benchmark_pdf_unavailable: PDF report generation is not connected to the Rust workspace. No PDF is produced by the page export.
benchmark_share_unavailable: Report sharing and the persistent exported-report index are not connected. No report is uploaded.
benchmark_orchestrate_unavailable: Macrobenchmark execution requires a Rust orchestration adapter. Importing a run never executes Gradle or starts device capture.
benchmark_trace_open_unavailable: Imported trace paths are metadata only. They are not authorized local file selections; open a trace explicitly in Trace Analyzer.
benchmark_reports_unavailable: Persistent report history is not connected; exported-page files are not a restored report catalog.
benchmark_trend_session_only: Trend points follow session import order, not verified build chronology. Missing build/commit identities are not invented.
benchmark_trend_not_comparable: Environment identity is incomplete or differs; do not treat these points as a comparable regression trend.
benchmark_trend_missing_samples: Reported medians without raw samples remain labelled as reported values; no sample count or high confidence is inferred.
benchmark_confidence_unavailable: A numeric confidence interval is not an Exact/Derived evidence-confidence label. The Rust analyzer does not publish that label.
benchmark_severity_unavailable: The Rust analyzer does not publish the reference confidence class, so High/Low regression severity is not inferred.
benchmark_no_traces: No trace artifact paths recorded for this case.
benchmark_policy_fixed_version: Analyzer policy version is fixed by the Rust implementation.
benchmark_policy_boundary: Rust supports relative/absolute thresholds, minimum samples, BCa iterations, confidence level and allowing inconclusive gates. Arbitrary blocking patterns and evidence-confidence policies are not connected.
benchmark_policy_invalid: Enter valid finite thresholds, sample and bootstrap bounds, and a confidence level between 0 and 1. Previous policy is retained.
benchmark_policy_applied: Comparison policy applied. Compare again to publish a new result.
benchmark_gate_fail_closed: Missing, incompatible or inconclusive required evidence fails closed unless inconclusive gates are explicitly allowed. No performance score is invented.
benchmark_gate_reason_empty: No comparisons are available; this is not release evidence.
benchmark_gate_reason_compatible: No blocking regression under the current Rust comparison policy.
